## Combo 277-1479-5671-5700-5701
Cards: Kodama of the East Tree + Petrified Field + Echoing Deeps + Tiller Engine + The Necrobloom
Color identity: WBG | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 10 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite creature tokens; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite landfall triggers
Start: Kodama of the East Tree (battlefield); Petrified Field (hand); Echoing Deeps (graveyard); Tiller Engine (battlefield); The Necrobloom (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
Steps: Play Petrified Field.
  When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and The Necrobloom trigger.
  Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
  Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
  When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
  When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom and Tiller Engine trigger.
  Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
  Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
  When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
  When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers.
  Repeat from step 4.

## Combo 277-3293-4693-5721
Cards: Emeria Shepherd + Aftermath Analyst + Overgrown Estate + Tiller Engine
Color identity: WBG | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 12 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite lifegain; Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite lifegain triggers; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite landfall triggers; Return all nonland permanents from your graveyard to the battlefield
Start: Emeria Shepherd (battlefield); Aftermath Analyst (battlefield); Overgrown Estate (battlefield); Tiller Engine (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
  You control a Plains.
Steps: Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
  Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
  Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
  Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
  When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd and Tiller Engine trigger that many times.
  Resolve all Tiller Engine triggers, untapping each land that entered.
  Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
  Repeat.
Notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.
